If the article is accurate, and the by-law is g/hr, it could easily be argued that consumers would have no way of knowing this value when they purchased their stove.

A more reasonable approach would have been to grandfather existing stoves and fireplaces and restrict new installations of stoves and fireplaces to meet existing environmental standards.
